content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (auth missing at service); silverbridge offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer, so requesting either would violate published rules. Resubmitting as-is or with records won't cure a missing auth and risks duplicate/repeat denial, and the balance can't be shifted to the patient since the auth failure is the provider's, not patient responsibility. With a denial on the table and reasonable documentation (0.85) plus 129 days of filing time left, a formal appeal arguing medical necessity is the only compliant path to collect the allowed amount.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
